title: Topical Tacrolimus in Vernal Keratoconjunctivitis
brief_summary: The main aim of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of topical tacrolimus 0.01% eyedrops in patients with vernal keratoconjunctivitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* with bilateral symmetrical palpebral and limbal vernal keratoconjunctivitis
* Patients 6-18 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant patients
* Patients on systemic therapy for other allergic disorders
* Patients who cannot come for follow-up
* Patients who are on other topical medications for other comorbid ocular conditions
